general.ayuda_contenido: Find a person and open their details. Choose to assign or remove profiles, select the assignments and choose their reasons. Review the changes before confirming. Administrator and Internal Control profiles need another person’s approval. The Profiles catalogue is read-only.

busqueda.vacia: No users match these filters. Change the search or clear the filters.
busqueda.lista: You can open a person’s details.

catalogo.descripcion: Profile definitions are fixed. You can view them here.

detalle.ambito_pendiente: Scope is not detailed in this view
detalle.resumen_pendiente: Open the details to view profiles
detalle.sin_actos: There are no changes of this type available for this person.
detalle.sin_historia: There are no actions in the authorised history.
detalle.historia_pendiente: This view does not include the names or reason for this action.
detalle.lista: Review the profiles, their scope and validity.
detalle.sin_revocacion_acceso: Complete access removal is not available yet. Accounts and sessions have not been revoked.

historia.motivo_pendiente: Reason is not detailed in this view

revision.doble: This change needs another person’s approval. Recording the proposal does not change access yet.
revision.efecto: Confirmation applies the reviewed changes. Removing an assignment preserves its history.
revision.verificar: Check the person, profiles, scope, validity and reasons before continuing.
revision.sin_lote: The service cannot confirm several profiles together yet. Review a single profile to continue.
revision.sin_conexion: Change confirmation is not connected yet. You can view and review assignments.
revision.motivo_lote: To confirm several profiles together, choose the same reason for all of them. No changes have been applied.

resultado.espera: Another administrator must review the proposal. Access changes remain pending.
resultado.efecto: The server has confirmed the change and its receipt. You can view the updated details.

errores.sin_conexion: The user query is not connected yet. No assignments have been loaded and no changes enabled.
errores.denegado: You are not authorised to view this information. It has been removed from the screen.
errores.lectura_retirada: The data could not be refreshed. Previous information has been removed. Select Reload to query again.
errores.conflicto: The assignment has changed. Return to the person’s details and review the updated information before continuing.
errores.filtros: The search service does not support these filters yet. Clear them or try again later.
errores.incompatible: The service response is incomplete. We cannot confirm the result. Reload the view or contact IT.
errores.servicio: The operation could not be completed. Retry with the same review; if it still fails, contact IT.
errores.seleccion: Select at least one profile and choose a reason for each selected profile.
errores.busqueda: Enter at least two characters to search by name.
errores.resultado_pendiente: The result is still pending. Retry this same confirmation before preparing another change.

propuestas.vacia: There are no proposals awaiting review.
propuestas.sin_consulta: Pending changes cannot be loaded yet.
propuestas.sin_cierre: You cannot confirm this proposal. Review details, another authorised person or the change connection are missing.
propuestas.efecto_aprobar: On confirmation, the server will check the proposal again and apply the authorised change.
propuestas.efecto_rechazar: On confirmation, the rejection will be kept. The person’s access will not change.

metadatos.catalogo_no_consultado: The role catalogue has not been read.
metadatos.alcance: This view shows assignments and their validity. Role names require a separate query.
metadatos.actos_no_consultados: Role changes are unavailable in this view.
metadatos.historia_no_consultada: The history has not been read.
metadatos.ayuda: You can open a record to check its assignments and validity dates. If your profile allows it, select “Change profiles” to assign or remove a profile: choose what to do, fill in the details, review them and confirm. This view does not include names that have not been read yet or the history.
metadatos.filtros_no_disponibles: You can filter by validity. Name search and role or unit filters are not yet available here.

lote.elegir: What would you like to do?
lote.retiradas_no_disponibles: We could not check the available profile changes. Select “Reload” to try again.
lote.sin_altas: There are no profiles to assign to this person in their unit.
lote.sin_bajas: This person has no profiles that can be removed in their unit.
lote.truncado: There are more profiles than shown. If you cannot find the one you need, contact IT.
lote.referencia_pista: If there is one, for example “Decision 1234/2026”.
lote.efecto_retirar: The person loses this profile as soon as you confirm.
lote.efecto_asignado: The change has been saved. The person will have the profile on the dates shown.
lote.efecto_retirado: The change has been saved. The person no longer has this profile.

errores.servicio: This could not be completed. Select “Start again”. If it keeps happening, contact IT.
errores.denegado: Your profile does not allow you to change this person's profiles.
errores.no_disponible: Profiles cannot be changed in this installation yet.
errores.conflicto: The person's details changed while you were preparing the change. Select “Start again” to see them again.
errores.invalido: Some details are not valid. Select “Start again” and check them.
errores.incierto: We have not received confirmation. You can retry this same request to find out what happened without starting another change.
errores.fecha_hasta: Enter an end date between today and {maxima}.
errores.fecha_desde: Enter a start date from tomorrow onwards.
errores.referencia: The reference is too long or contains invalid characters.
errores.fecha_hasta_inicio: The end date must be after the start date.
